responsibility: Defines the `ObligationForest` data structure and its processing model for tracking outstanding obligations as dependency trees. This file owns obligation storage, deduplication caches, node state transitions, backtrace construction, cycle detection, completion/error collection, and compaction of resolved nodes, while exposing the traits and result types used by processors to register and advance obligations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this is a stateful obligation-processing engine with caching, suspension, backtraces, and cycle/error handling; even though it manages dependency trees internally, it is a higher-level workflow component rather than a general graph module or a simple container wrapper.
